csv_scope_of_work: The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Sacramento District (SPK) anticipates a forthcoming solicitation for design-build (DB) construction services for the National Security Agency-Utah (NSA-U) Consolidation Mission Facility (CMF) at Camp Williams, Utah. title: Design-Build for Camp Williams NSA-U Consolidated Mission Facility
short_description: Design-build construction services for a consolidated mission facility at Camp Williams, Utah.
project_scope: Anticipated solicitation for design-build construction services for the National Security Agency-Utah Consolidated Mission Facility at Camp Williams in Lehi, Utah. The notice indicates a general building project but provides no technical data such as gross floor area, height, span lengths, structural system, or specific building components.
services: Design-build construction services for a consolidated mission facility; planning and construction are bundled in one contract.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with a design-build component, so there is some potential structural planning involvement.
- However, the notice describes a general building/mission facility without any indication of special spans, lightweight structures, roofs, facades, bridges, or architecturally demanding features.
- Military/security facility type is generally not a strategic priority for sbp.
- No explicit structural engineering scope, innovative materials, or sustainability ambitions are stated.
- Limited technical information reduces current strategic attractiveness.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available information for a future estimate is limited to: design-build delivery, general building target market, military mission facility, and location at Camp Williams in Lehi, Utah.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Since neither construction cost nor structural engineering scope is defined, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the provided notice alone.
